title: 第162章 四手联弹第161章 偶遇
content_zh:
“怎么哭了？”傅心莲走到白月身边，目光落在她脸上，当看到那一划泪痕，有些慌了神。
他连忙走到她面前，微微俯身，用拇指轻轻拭去她脸上的泪水。
“怎么一个人跑出来了？嗯？”傅心莲的声音很温柔，像耳边呢喃的低语。
“你知道我在这儿？”这下轮到白月有些惊讶了，她扬起一张小脸，脸上的粉底有些被眼泪和傅心莲的擦拭晕开了。
“小花脸猫。”傅心莲轻笑一声，拿出一方手帕，为她轻轻抹匀脸上的粉底。
“龙子真跟我提过招商要问你的意见，今天是招商舞会，你又跟我说有事，我很难猜不出来。”傅心莲凝视着白月的脸庞，泛起一个清浅的笑容。
“所以你是在这里等我的吗？”白月也看着傅心莲，吸了吸鼻子，她感觉到刚刚流泪时鼻尖有些酸。
“倒也不全是，云澜是傅家的产业，我也只是恰好在办公室里待久了，出来晒晒月光。”
傅心莲说着，把自己的长袖外衬解下，披到了白月身上。
两人靠近时，傅心莲的鼻息轻呼在白月的脸上，伴随着一阵若有若无的檀香，让白月耳根一红。
她抬头，清亮的月光洒在傅心莲的长发上，像是给他整个人镀了一层薄薄的银边。
月光从侧面照过来，白月能感觉到他的睫毛在微微垂着，那一下颤动很轻，像是风刚好从那个角度掠过去，又像是他本来就在犹豫什么，只是借着风掩饰了一下。
她垂着眼，看到他的喉结正随着呼吸的节奏，微微动着，带着一点不易察觉的紧绷。她忽然觉得这个时候应该说点什么，但张开嘴的时候又不知道该说什么。
“天有些凉了，要不进去吧？”傅心莲轻轻抓起白月的双手，让白月的心跳差点漏了一拍，但很快她便发现他是在给她输送内力取暖，她笑了笑，便任由他牵着了。
只见白月又摇了摇头，说：“我不想回去了。“她说这话的时候眼睛看着他，没有躲开，“人太多了，说话太累。“
傅心莲的目光在她脸上停了一瞬，温柔地说，“那就不回去，你有想去的地方吗？“
“去哪里都可以，你带我去就行。”
白月说完这句话之后忽然觉得好像有点太直接了，她垂下眼，假装看着自己踩在月光里的鞋尖。
傅心莲牵起了她的手，往另一个方向走去。
他们不知道的是，龙子真正好一个尿遁的功夫，就看到了露台这边的两个人。

隔着玻璃，龙子真的表情是先一愣，然后他看到了傅心莲牵着白月的手，那表情就变成了“我看到了什么“。
傅心莲显然很熟悉这里的路，白月跟在他身后穿过一条不长的走廊，墙上挂着的画在昏黄的壁灯下泛着暗调的光，地上铺着深色的地毯，脚步落上去几乎没有声音。
车已经在侧门外等好了，白月看了一眼，不是傅心莲平常坐的那辆黑色轿车，是一辆银灰色的车，停在一棵梧桐树下面，车身在路灯下反着一层浅光。
小轩靠在车门边，看到傅心莲和白月出来，没有多问，只是拉开后座的门，动作自然而利落。
车子发动之后，小轩问了一句：“傅少，去哪？“
傅心莲报了一个地址，白月没听过那个地方的名字，但也没有多问，乖乖地坐在车里。
窗外的街景开始变化，路灯的光从车窗外依次滑过，在车厢里明灭交替。白月靠在座椅上，侧着头看窗外，没有说话，但她能感觉到傅心莲手掌的温度。
车子最后停在一条不起眼的巷子里，白月下车的时候抬头看了看，面前是一栋不太高的建筑，外墙是深灰色的砖石结构，窗户是窄长的拱形，透出温润的淡黄色灯光，像是一座旧洋楼。
傅心莲牵着白月走在前面，轻轻推开了那扇墨绿色的铁门，穿过一条不长的通道，尽头的楼梯很窄，扶手是深色的木质，已经被磨出了一层温润的光泽。
墙壁上间隔挂着几盏小壁灯，光晕昏黄而均匀，把空间收拢成一种安静的氛围。
二楼的空间比她想象的要大，整层楼贯通成一个房间，三面都是高高的窗户，能看到远处城市的轮廓。
房间角落里有一架旧钢琴，琴盖合着，上面放着一盏灯和一个插着几支干花的花瓶。
“这里平时没人来，是我偶尔会待的地方。“傅心莲让白月在沙发上先坐下，走到一旁给她倒了一杯水。
“这是你小时候住的地方吧？”白月忽然开口一问。
“你怎么知道？”傅心莲把倒好的温水递给她。
白月接过水杯的时候，指尖碰到了杯壁，刚好是她能直接入口的温度。她没有立刻喝，只是捧在手心，目光环顾着整个房间。
为什么她会这么问？是因为看到这部钢琴的时候，她的脑子里忽然闪过一个画面。

"Why are you crying?" Fu Xinlian walked to Bai Yue, her eyes fell on her face, and she panicked when she saw the tear marks.
He quickly walked up to her, leaned over slightly, and gently wiped away the tears on her face with his thumb.
"Why did a person run out? Huh?" Fu Xinlian's voice was very gentle, like a whisper in the ear.
"Do you know I'm here?" It was Bai Yue's turn to be a little surprised. She raised a small face, and the foundation on her face was somewhat blurred by tears and Fu Xinlian's wiping.
"Little cat with a colorful face." Fu Xinlian chuckled, took out a handkerchief, and gently spread the foundation on her face.
"Long Zi really told me that I want to ask your opinion on the investment promotion. Today is the investment promotion dance, and you told me that you have something to do. It's hard for me not to guess." Fu Xinlian stared at Bai Yue's face, with a faint smile.
"So are you waiting for me here?" Bai Yue also looked at Fu Xinlian and sniffed. She felt that the tip of her nose was a little sore from the tears she just shed.
"That's not entirely true. Yunlan is the property of the Fu family. I just happened to stay in the office for a long time and came out to bask in the moonlight."
Fu Xinlian said, taking off her long-sleeved outer lining and putting it on Bai Yue.
When the two of them got close, Fu Xinlian's breath blew softly on Bai Yue's face, accompanied by a faint scent of sandalwood, which made Bai Yue's ears turn red.
She looked up, and the clear moonlight shone on Fu Xinlian's long hair, as if plating a thin layer of silver on his whole body.
The moonlight shone from the side, and Bai Yue could feel his eyelashes hanging slightly. The trembling was very light, as if the wind just passed by from that angle, or as if he was hesitating about something in the first place, but he just used the wind to cover it up.
She lowered her eyes and saw that his Adam's apple was moving slightly with the rhythm of his breathing, with a little bit of imperceptible tightness. She suddenly felt that she should say something at this time, but when she opened her mouth, she didn't know what to say.
"It's getting cold, why don't you go in?" Fu Xinlian gently grabbed Bai Yue's hands, causing Bai Yue's heartbeat to almost miss a beat, but soon she realized that he was sending her inner energy to keep her warm. She smiled and let him hold her.
Bai Yue shook her head again and said, "I don't want to go back." When she said this, she looked at him without looking away, "There are too many people, and talking is too tiring."
Fu Xinlian's eyes paused on her face for a moment and said softly, "Then don't go back. Do you have somewhere you want to go?"
"I can go anywhere, just take me there."
After Bai Yue said this, she suddenly felt that it seemed a bit too direct. She lowered her eyes and pretended to look at the toes of her shoes in the moonlight.
Fu Xinlian took her hand and walked in the other direction.
What they didn't know was that when Ryuko was really good at urinating, he saw the two people on the terrace.
Across the glass, Long Zi's expression was startled for a moment. Then he saw Fu Xinlian holding Bai Yue's hand, and his expression changed to "I saw something."
Fu Xinlian was obviously very familiar with the road here. Bai Yue followed him through a short corridor. The paintings hanging on the wall glowed dimly under the dim yellow wall lamps. The floor was covered with dark carpets, and the footsteps made almost no sound.
The car was already waiting outside the side door. Bai Yue took a look and saw that it was not the black car Fu Xinlian usually sat in, but a silver-gray car parked under a sycamore tree. The car body reflected a light light under the street lights.
Xiaoxuan leaned against the car door and saw Fu Xinlian and Bai Yue coming out. Without asking any questions, he just opened the back seat door with a natural and neat movement.
After the car started, Xiaoxuan asked: "Master Fu, where are you going?"
Fu Xinlian reported an address. Bai Yue had never heard the name of that place, but she didn't ask any more questions and sat in the car obediently.
The street scene outside the window began to change, and the light from the street lamps slid through the car window one after another, and alternated between on and off in the car. Bai Yue leaned on the seat,She looked out the window sideways and said nothing, but she could feel the warmth of Fu Xinlian's palms.
The car finally stopped in an inconspicuous alley. When Bai Yue got off the car, she looked up and saw a not-too-tall building in front of her. The exterior wall was made of dark gray masonry and the windows were long and narrow arches, revealing a warm light yellow light. It looked like an old Western-style building.
Fu Xinlian led Bai Yue in front, gently pushed open the dark green iron door, and walked through a short passage. The stairs at the end were very narrow, and the handrails were made of dark wood that had been polished to a warm luster.
Several small wall lamps are hung at intervals on the wall, and the light is dim and even, bringing the space into a quiet atmosphere.
The space on the second floor was larger than she had imagined. The entire floor was connected into one room. There were tall windows on three sides, and she could see the outline of the city in the distance.
There was an old piano in the corner of the room, with the lid closed, and a lamp and a vase with some dried flowers on it.
"No one usually comes here. It's a place where I stay occasionally." Fu Xinlian asked Bai Yue to sit down on the sofa first, then walked to the side and poured her a glass of water.
"Is this the place where you lived when you were a child?" Bai Yue suddenly asked.
"How do you know?" Fu Xinlian handed her the warm water.
When Bai Yue took the water cup, her fingertips touched the wall of the cup, which was just warm enough for her to drink it directly. She didn't drink it immediately, she just held it in her hand and looked around the room.
Why would she ask that? It was because when she saw this piano, a picture suddenly flashed in her mind.
